Usage:
  enlightenment_info -version 
  enlightenment_info -protocol_trace [console|file_path|disable]
  enlightenment_info -protocol_rule [COMMAND] [ARG]...
	add    : add the rule to trace events (Usage: add [allow|deny] [RULE(iface=wl_touch and msg=down)]
	remove  : remove the rule (Usage: remove [all|RULE_INDEX])
	file    : add rules from file (Usage: file [RULE_FILE_PATH])
	print   : print current rules
	help

  enlightenment_info -eina_log_levels [mymodule1:5,mymodule2:2]
  enlightenment_info -eina_log_path [console|file_path]
  enlightenment_info -dlog [on:1,off:0]
  enlightenment_info -trace [hwc | exsync] [off: 0, on: 1]


  enlightenment_info -compobjs [simple]
  enlightenment_info -connected_clients 
  enlightenment_info -fps [COMMAND] [ARG]...
	-help             : print this message.
	-win_id           : print client fps.
Example:
	winfo -fps
	winfo -fps -win_id [win_id]

  enlightenment_info -hwc_wins 
  enlightenment_info -input_devices 
  enlightenment_info -input_region 
  enlightenment_info -keygrab_status 
  enlightenment_info -keymap 
  enlightenment_info -module_info 
  enlightenment_info -output_mode [output idx] [mode number]
  enlightenment_info -reslist [-tree|-p]
	-tree     : All resources
	-p {pid}  : Specify client pid

  enlightenment_info -screen_info 
  enlightenment_info -subsurface 
  enlightenment_info -topvwins 
  enlightenment_info -topwins 
  enlightenment_info -view 
  enlightenment_info -wininfo [-options ...]

where options include:
	-help             : print this message.
	-children         : print parent and child identifiers.
	-tree             : print children identifiers recursively.
	-stats            : print window geometry [DEFAULT]
	-id windowid      : use the window with the specified id
	-name windowname  : use the window with the specified name
	-pid windowpid    : use the window with the specified id
	-int              : print window id in decimal
	-size             : print size hints
	-wm               : print window manager hints
	-shape            : print shape rectangles
	-all              : -tree, -stats, -wm, -size, -shape
Example:
	enlightenment_info -wininfo
	enlightenment_info -wininfo -id [win_id] -all
	enlightenment_info -wininfo -children -stats -size
	enlightenment_info -wininfo -name [win_name] -tree -wm
	enlightenment_info -wininfo -pid [win_pid] -size -shape -int



  enlightenment_info -aux_hint [window] [hint id] [hint] [value]
  enlightenment_info -aux_msg [window] [key] [value] [options]
  enlightenment_info -basic_op_gen -basic_op_gen {window id} ( lower | activate | iconify | uniconify )
Example:
	winfo -basic_op_gen basic_op_gen lower

  enlightenment_info -bgcolor_set [<a>,<r>,<g>,<b>]
  enlightenment_info -buffer_flush [on <win_id / all>], [off <win_id / all>], [show <win_id / all>]
  enlightenment_info -deiconify_approve [on <win_id / all>], [off <win_id / all>], [show <win_id / all>]
  enlightenment_info -desk [Option..] [DIR]
	geometry [ x][ y][ w][ h]     : change desktop screen given geometry
	zoom     [zx][zy][cx][cy]     : scale desktop screen
Example:
	winfo -desk geometry 0 0 480 720
	winfo -desk zoom 0.5 0.5 0 0

  enlightenment_info -dump [Option..] [DIR]
	topvwins     : Dump buffer commit on top visible clients
	ns           : Dump native surfaces set on clients
	hwc_wins     : Dump buffer displayed by hwc_windows

  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers   enlightenment_info -dump_buffers [ARG]...
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1                : start dump buffer (default - buffer_count:100, path:/tmp/dump_xxxx/
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1 -m             : start dump buffer with marking of various color
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1 -c 50          : start dump buffer with 50 buffers
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1 -p /tmp/test   : start dump buffer - the dump path is '/tmp/test/dump_xxxx'

  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 0                : stop dump buffer (store dump files to dump path)
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1 -s 0.5         : start dump buffer with 0.5 scale factor
  enlightenment_info -dump_buffers 1 -w Wind_ID or server or client : start dump buffer with specific window or server or client
  enlightenment_info -dump_selected_buffers Win_ID(from enlightenment_info -topvwins)   : dump Win_ID(store dump files to dump path)

  enlightenment_info -dump_memory file dumped under /tmp dir.

  enlightenment_info -effect [on: 1, off: 0]
  enlightenment_info -filter -filter {window id} ( blur | grayscale | inverse ) ( on | off)
Example:
	winfo -filter blur on
	winfo -filter blur off
	winfo -filter grayscale on
	winfo -filter grayscale off
	winfo -filter inverse_color on
	winfo -filter inverse_color off

	winfo -filter 0xabcabcde blur on
	winfo -filter 0xbcaa11aa grayscale off

  enlightenment_info -focus_history 
  enlightenment_info -focus_policy_ext [0], [1]
  enlightenment_info -frender (all | cls | canvas)
Commands:
	all      : updates client's surface and canvas 
	cls      : updates client's surface only
	canvas   : updates canvas adding damage in fullscreen size
Example:
	enlightenment_info -frender all
	enlightenment_info -frender cls
	enlightenment_info -frender canvas

  enlightenment_info -gcov 
  enlightenment_info -hwc [on: 1, off: 0, 2: info]
  enlightenment_info -input_output_set [input(ex./dev/input/eventX) output(ex.HDMIA-1)]
  enlightenment_info -input_seat_set [input(ex./dev/input/eventX) seat(ex.seat_bluetooth)]
  enlightenment_info -key_repeat [print] [set <delay> <rate>]
  enlightenment_info -kill [COMMAND] [ARG]...
	-id     : the identifier for the resource whose creator is to be killed.
	-name   : the name for the resource whose creator is to be killed.
	-pid    : the pid for the resource whose creator is to be killed.
	-pid -f : the pid of the client is going to be killed immediately.
	-all    : kill all clients with top level windows
	-help
Example:
	enlightenment_info -kill
	enlightenment_info -kill [win_id]
	enlightenment_info -kill -id [win_id]
	enlightenment_info -kill -name [win_name]
	enlightenment_info -kill -pid [pid]
	enlightenment_info -kill -pid [pid] -f
	enlightenment_info -kill -all
	enlightenment_info -kill -help

  enlightenment_info -kvm_transparent [0:unset(opaque), 1:set(transparent)]
  enlightenment_info -log {log type} (1 | 0) 
	log type : log type to enable/disable
	           input_log_enable
	           key_input_ttrace_enable
Example:
	winfo -log input_log_enable 1
	winfo -log key_input_ttrace_enable 1
	winfo -log buffer_serial_log_enable 1

  enlightenment_info -magnifier 
  enlightenment_info -module [list], [load <module_name>], [unload <module_name>]
  enlightenment_info -mtrace [enable: 1, disable: 0]
  enlightenment_info -process_info 
  enlightenment_info -prop 0x<win_id> | -id win_id | -pid pid | -name "win_name" [property_name [property_value]]
Example:
	enlightenment_info -prop                        : Get all properties for a window specified via a touch
	enlightenment_info -prop Hidden                 : Get the "Hidden" property for a window specified via a touch
	enlightenment_info -prop 0xb88ffaa0 Layer       : Get the "Layer" property for specified window
	enlightenment_info -prop 0xb88ffaa0 Hidden TRUE : Set the "Hidden" property for specified window
	enlightenment_info -prop -pid 2502 Hidden FALSE : Set the "Hidden" property for all windows belonged to a process
	enlightenment_info -prop -name err              : Get all properties for windows whose names contain an "err" substring
	enlightenment_info -prop -name ""               : Get all properties for all windows
	enlightenment_info -prop -name "" Hidden TRUE   : Set the "Hidden" property for all windows

  enlightenment_info -prop_set -prop_set {window id} ( pin | modal ) ( 1 | 0) 
Example:
	winfo -prop_set 0x12345678 pin 1
	winfo -prop_set 0x12345678 modal 1
	winfo -prop_set 0x12345678 skip_zoom 1

  enlightenment_info -punch [on/off] [<X>x<H>+<X>+<Y>] [<a>,<r>,<g>,<b>]
  enlightenment_info -quickpanel -quickpanel (0:hide | 1:show | 2:lock | 3:unlock) {window id}
	window id : This is an optional value. If you want to control specific
	            quickpanel service, then use this parameter.
,Example:
	winfo -quickpanel 0 : hide default quickpanel service
	winfo -quickpanel 1 : show default quickpanel service
	winfo -quickpanel 2 : set scroll_lock for quickpanel service
	winfo -quickpanel 3 : unset scoll_lock for quickpanel service
	winfo -quickpanel 1 0x0a710a07 : show the specific quickpanel service

  enlightenment_info -remote_surface enlightenment_info -remote_surface (info | dump)
Commands:
	info : print current remote surface info
	dump : on/off to dump provider's buffer by -dump_buffers [0:off, 1:on]
Example:
	enlightenment_info -remote_surface info
	enlightenment_info -remote_surface dump 0
	enlightenment_info -remote_surface dump 1

  enlightenment_info -resize_ppu [windowID ppu_value]
  enlightenment_info -rotation [COMMAND] [ARG]...
	set     : Set the orientation of zone (Usage: set [zone-no] [rval(0|90|180|270)]
	info    : Get the information of zone's rotation (Usage: info [zone-no]) (Not Implemented)
	enable  : Enable the rotation of zone (Usage: enable [zone-no]
	disable : Disable the rotation of zone (Usage: disable [zone-no]

  enlightenment_info -screen_rotation [0|90|180|270]
  enlightenment_info -screen_rotation_pre [0|90|180|270]
  enlightenment_info -scrsaver (info | enable | disable | timeout <sec>)

Commands:
	info    : Get the current information about the screen saver
	enable  : Enable the screen saver function
	disable : Disable the screen saver function
	timeout : Set timeout period of the screen saver in seconds

Example:
	enlightenment_info -scrsaver info
	enlightenment_info -scrsaver timeout 15.7
	enlightenment_info -scrsaver enable
